entries.scope: Control the crystal structure of cocoa butter in chocolate to obtain the intended set, appearance and texture. This is the chocolate sense of tempering, distinct from tempering eggs or spices.

Gradually equalise temperature when combining eggs, custards or similar mixtures with a hotter component, limiting abrupt heating and unwanted coagulation. This is not chocolate tempering or spice tempering.

Bloom spices in hot fat to develop and carry their flavour. Spice tempering has culturally specific names and practices, including tadka and related traditions; those words are not silently made universal aliases. This is distinct from tempering chocolate or eggs.
